prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Baytown, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1248; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the parking lot collision you reported in Baytown. Can you confirm you're comfortable being recorded?

A: Yes, that's fine.

Q: Please describe in your own words what happened when the collision occurred.

A: I was backing out of a parking space near the store entrance. I checked my mirrors and didn't see anything, but as I reversed, the other vehicle came around the end of the row and struck the rear passenger side of my car.

Q: How fast would you estimate you were going at the time of impact?

A: I was barely moving, maybe a walking pace. It was a slow back-up.

Q: Where were you looking just before the impact?

A: Mostly over my right shoulder, toward the open lane behind me. I didn't see the other car until it was already close.

Q: Were you injured in the collision?

A: Yes. My right knee hit the dashboard and the door frame when the impact jolted the car. It's been swollen and sore since then.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment for the knee?

A: I went to an urgent care clinic the same afternoon. They took X-rays and told me to rest it, use ice, and follow up with my regular doctor if it doesn't improve.

Q: Are you currently experiencing any limitations because of the knee?

A: Yes, I have trouble with stairs and I can't drive for long periods because I can't keep my leg bent comfortably.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add about the collision or your injuries?

A: Only that I'm willing to provide my medical records and any photos I took at the scene.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.

A: Thank you.
